title: ERC Funded Postdoctoral Positions in Theoretical Particle Physics, Theoretical Cosmology/Gravitation
institution: Institut de Física d'Altes Energies (IFAE), Theory Division
field: Theoretical particle physics and cosmology/gravitation (high-frequency gravitational waves)
about: IFAE's Theory Division in Barcelona is recruiting ERC-funded postdocs for theoretical work on searches for high-frequency gravitational waves, as full-time positions starting in fall 2027. Applications are due 31 December 2026.
